existing.description: The Padua International Excellence Scholarship Programme awards up to 76 scholarships to high-achieving international students entering an English-taught first-cycle or master's degree at the University of Padua. Each award is worth €8,000.00 gross per academic year plus exemption from student fees, with beneficiaries paying only the regional fee and the revenue stamp. Scholarships run for a maximum of two years on master's courses and three years on bachelor's or single-cycle courses, paid in two instalments and conditional on earning at least 20 CFU by 30 November each year. Eligibility follows automatically from the degree course application.
eligibility: Must not hold Italian citizenship, unless holding dual citizenship
Must hold a non-Italian secondary school diploma for bachelor's or single-cycle degree courses
Must hold a foreign degree diploma for master's degree courses
Must not be resident in Italy at the time of application
Must apply to an English-taught degree at the University of Padua within the deadline
Must not be a recipient of another scholarship
Must complete enrolment at the University of Padua
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to candidates who do not hold Italian citizenship (unless dual), hold a non-Italian secondary school diploma for bachelor's and single-cycle courses or a foreign degree diploma for master's courses, are not resident in Italy at the time of application, and apply to an English-taught degree at the University of Padua within the deadline.
benefits: €8,000.00 gross allowance per academic year, paid in two instalments of €4,000.00
Exemption from student fees for each academic year
Up to 76 scholarships awarded per round
coverage: Cash allowance of €8,000.00 gross per academic year
Exemption from student fees for each academic year
requirements: Submit the degree course application within the admission deadline
Accept the admission offer through apply.unipd.it and pay the admission fee
Fulfil any missing admission requirements, such as entry qualification and English language certificate
Complete enrolment at the University of Padua
Earn at least 20 CFU (ECTS credits) by 30 November of each subsequent academic year to retain the scholarship
documents: Only the documents required to apply for the chosen degree programme, since no separate scholarship application or additional documentation is needed
application_method: Apply to the English-taught degree programme; scholarship eligibility is automatic
existing.selection_notes: The selection process is highly competitive and only candidates with the highest scores and the best course track succeed. The Teaching Committee of each degree course selects admitted candidates based on academic excellence in their field of study and the quality and results of their previous academic career. Results are published on the University website according to the deadlines in the Admission Notice.
existing.best_fit: Non-Italian students without Italian residency applying to an English-taught bachelor's, single-cycle or master's degree at the University of Padua with an outstanding academic record.
existing.notes: The scholarship may be revoked if a recipient does not earn at least 20 CFU by 30 November of the following academic year, or decides to transfer to another university or withdraw; in that case the instalments already received must be returned. Beneficiaries remain liable for the regional fee and the revenue stamp each academic year, and must pay the tuition fees due until graduation after the maximum scholarship period ends. The degree course application automatically makes the candidate eligible, so no separate application or additional documentation is required.
existing.duration: 2 years for master's degree programmes; 3 years for bachelor's and/or single-cycle degree programmes
existing.application_period: Tied to the English-taught degree application cycle. For 2027/28 entry the first application window for candidates with foreign qualifications closes on 15 November 2026; Calls for Application for the scholarship are published in November 2026.
existing.deadline_display: There is no separate scholarship application: "The application for the degree course of your interest automatically makes you eligible to compete for the award of the scholarship provided you meet the requirements listed above." Candidates must "apply to an English-taught degree at the University of Padova within the deadline", and the University states that for 2027/28 the first application window "closes on 15 November 2026" while the scholarship Calls for Application will be published in November 2026.

scholarships.title: ITALYOU - L'Italia nel tuo futuro (MAECI scholarship for the ItAS Master's degree, University for Foreigners of Perugia)
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI), Italy

existing.funding_period: per academic year, paid in 12 monthly instalments
existing.description: ITALYOU is a scholarship programme of the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI), run with the University for Foreigners of Perugia, that funds the ItAS master's degree course 'ItAS - Italian for Teaching to Foreigners'. It targets young scholars from selected African countries. The fourth edition covers academic year 2026-2027 and awards 70 new annual scholarships of EUR 8,000 each, paid in 12 monthly instalments starting 1 October 2026, plus 64 renewals for third-edition holders who have passed at least 40 CFU. Selection is coordinated by the University for Foreigners of Perugia with its partner institutions and the Italian diplomatic missions in each target country.
eligibility: Citizens of one of the listed target countries: Algeria, Cameroon, Egypt, Ethiopia, Libya, Morocco, Senegal, Somalia, South Africa, Tunisia
Willingness to attend the ItAS master's degree course held at the University for Foreigners of Perugia, Italy
Applicants must apply through the selection coordinated by the University for Foreigners of Perugia and its partner institutions
existing.eligibility_summary: Young scholars holding citizenship of one of the programme's target African countries who apply through the University for Foreigners of Perugia's partner institutions and the Italian diplomatic mission in their country. The award funds the ItAS master's degree only.
benefits: EUR 8,000 scholarship paid in 12 monthly instalments
Scholarship payments begin 1 October 2026 for the 4th edition (AY 2026-2027)
coverage: Cash scholarship of EUR 8,000 per scholar per academic year, paid in 12 monthly instalments
The official page states nothing about tuition fees, accommodation or travel costs
requirements: The scholarship funds the ItAS master's degree programme 'ItAS - Italian for Teaching to Foreigners' held at the University for Foreigners of Perugia
Renewal for third-edition holders requires passing exams worth at least 40 university credits (CFU)
application_method: Selection is coordinated by the University for Foreigners of Perugia with the support of its partner institutions in each target country
Italian diplomatic missions in the target countries take an active part in the selection through designated representatives
existing.selection_notes: Applicants are routed through the University for Foreigners of Perugia's partner entities and Italian diplomatic missions, so the application route and the closing date depend on the candidate's country and on the edition.
existing.notes: Programme launched in academic year 2023-2024 under the Mattei Plan for Africa. Country quotas and the number of awards differ per edition; the 4th edition lists new awards for Algeria, Cameroon, Egypt, Libya, Morocco, Senegal and Tunisia, while the programme's target-country list on the same page also includes Ethiopia, Somalia and South Africa.
existing.duration: One academic year, disbursed in 12 monthly instalments
existing.application_period: Annual edition. The 4th edition covers academic year 2026-2027, with scholarships starting 1 October 2026.
existing.program_type: Master's degree scholarship programme (ItAS - Italian for Teaching to Foreigners)
